fail_closed_rule: This disposition releases the readiness block only while the recorded decision is U3 and its status is RESOLVED. Withdraw the decision or substitute U1, U2 or U4 and zero UNCERTAIN coverage blocks readiness again under the original stop code.

non_accepted_option_requirements.U1: construct-set route form -- a scoring unit would stop being one authorized construct and the accepted-rate denominator would change meaning. Neither was done.
non_accepted_option_requirements.U2: artifact-absence route form -- target selection would become a function of which authorized artifact is absent. Not done.
non_accepted_option_requirements.U4: extend the corpus with single-construct UNCERTAIN properties -- new routes would enter the denominator and explicit user authorization would be required for a new corpus version. Not done.

gate_result_verbatim.rationale: No candidate-scoring P06 property asserts UNCERTAIN as the correct support status, so a qualification run cannot observe whether a candidate reaches UNCERTAIN when the deciding artifact is absent. The instrument must not manufacture that coverage.

pre_u3_uncertain_coverage_gate.why_it_is_not_active: The gate stops the readiness path *until* a product decision is made. One was made, so its stop condition is discharged. Nothing about the coverage fact it reports changed.
pre_u3_uncertain_coverage_gate.why_retained: The stop that produced a product decision is the evidence that the decision was made deliberately rather than assumed. Deleting it would leave U3 looking like a default.

uncovered_is_not_unresolved: UNCOVERED is a fact about the instrument: no candidate-scoring P06 property asserts UNCERTAIN, so a qualification run cannot observe that behaviour. UNRESOLVED was a fact about the product: nobody had decided what to do about it. U3 decides what to do. It does not, and must not, make the status covered.
what_changed_from_v132: 1.3.2 carried the pre-decision gate as its active state, so an active field still demanded a product decision that Phase 9B.7 had already made. 1.3.3 publishes the post-decision disposition and retains that gate as explicitly historical evidence.
what_did_not_change_from_v132: the coverage status: UNCERTAIN is UNCOVERED in both
the candidate-scoring property count for UNCERTAIN: zero in both
the production contract: UNCERTAIN remains a member in both
every semantic route, property, split, threshold and bar
what_u3_does_not_resolve: the coverage itself. UNCERTAIN stays unexercised, unqualified and an explicit residual risk.
what_u3_resolves: the question of what to do about zero UNCERTAIN semantic coverage
